_about: What RoccobotOS takes from elsewhere, at which version, and where its new versions appear. check-dependencies.py of roccobot.github.io (.memo/scripts), run from this repo's root, compares the version in use (vendor/package.json, the one place it is written) with the latest published on npm; a newer one is read for what is worth bringing in before it is taken (Roccobot.md, 'Le dipendenze si seguono'). The weekly workflow .github/workflows/dependencies.yml runs it every Monday. A new tocbot comes in as its dist/tocbot.min.js (npm pack tocbot@<version>) in the inline script of index.html, with the same one change.

dependencies.name: tocbot
dependencies.into: the inline script before </head> of index.html: the side index. It is dist/tocbot.min.js of the npm package, with the only change of replaceChildren() for the one innerHTML (in destroy(), which empties the list)
